title: Dolfinarium, kreten van dolfijnen - SoundCloud - Beeld en Geluid
author: Beeld en Geluid
changes: Bottlenose dolphin calls recorded in air at a Dutch dolphinarium. Trimmed to 1.35–2.50 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
